test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Ballary - Chitradurga - Chikmagalur - Tumkur belt located in Karnataka is a rich source of which ore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron ore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ballary-Chitradurga-Chikmagalur-Tumkur belt **located in **Karnataka **is renowned for its vast **reserves of iron ore**.
 
• It is considered one of the major iron ore belts in India, contributing significantly to the country's iron and steel industry.
 
• The** Kudremukh mines**, located in the **Western Ghats of Karnataka**, are entirely focused on exports.
 
• A pipeline carries the ore in a slurry form to a port close to Mangalore.
 
• One of the **three main iron ore belts** is the one that runs through **Odisha and Jharkhand**.
 
 
• The other two are the **Bellary-Chitradurga-Chikmagalur-Tumkur belt** and the **Durg-Bastar Chandrapur belt**.
 
 
 
• The Odisha-Jharkhand belt's Badampahar mines produce high-grade hematite ore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manganese ore** can be found in the districts of **Balaghat**, **Chhindwara**, and **Jhabua **in **Madhya Pradesh**, in **Nagpur **and **Bhandara **in **Maharashtra** and **Sundargarh**, **Koraput**, and **Ganjam **in **Odisha**.
 
• The major **copper mines **are the **Khetri **copper belt in **Rajasthan**, **Singhbhum **copper belt in **Jharkhand **and **Malanjkhand copper belt in Madhya Pradesh** which are mined by HCL.
 
 
• **Singhbhum **belt is mined by **M/s Indian Copper Complex**.
 
 
 
• **Titanium Sponge Plant of India** is located at Kerala Minerals and Metals Ltd (KMML), Chavara, **Kollam district of Kerala.**
